tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (481)༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i khro rgyal rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bklags chog tu bkod pa ye shes grub pa zhes
(481)༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i khro rgyal rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bklags chog tu bkod pa ye shes grub pa zhes

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (481)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i khro rgyal rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bklags chog tu bkod pa ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(482)༄༅// sangs rgyas khros pa'i he ru ka /kun 'dus 'jigs byed rdo rje shugs// srid gsum g.yul las rab rgyal des// bgegs nyams 'dod don kun 'grub shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa rnams kyis rgyud nas bsngags pa'i sde drug srung ma cug cu gtso bo dang bcas pa la gtor ma 'bul ba sogs las kyi rim pa la'ang 'di'i rjes gnang thob pa gal che zhing*/ khyad par rdzogs rim mun khrid kyi sngon du 'di'i byin rlabs nges par bya dgos pas de ltar bsgrub pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng du maṇ+ḍal pad+ma ljang gu lte bar nyi zla sgra gcan mtshon byed kyi gdan dmar dkar nag gsum brtsegs pa la tshom bu ljang khu gcig bkod// mchod pa bcu gnyis po 'phreng la bsgrigs pa'am/ phyogs phyogs su 'god na/ steng gi gnyis shar dang*/ 'og gi gnyis nub kyi gral la 'god// de la shar du dri chab dang*/ me tog /lho ru spos dang mer ram// byang du zhal zas dang shing tog /nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma mtshon pa'i na bza' dang me long steng gi sgra ma'i ting shags sogs rol mo gang rung dang*/ gar ma'i rdor dril lta bu/ 'og tu 'dod ma'i chos 'byung dang*/ glu ma mtshon byed kyi pi waṃ rnams bshams/ dbus su gtor ma zlum gtor dpal can 'god/ (483)'bul gtor gtso 'khor bdun pa'am zur drug pa bshams/ sgrub pa po'i mdun tu nang mchod rdor dril cang te'u sogs chang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la/ thog mar nang mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī phaṭa kyi sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang mchod yon dang*/ dri dang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang*/

in+d+ra ni la la sogs pa'i rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*/ nang gi dam tshig dang*/ dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa'i kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ de bzhin tu/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ nai wi t+yaṃ/ ak+ṣa tuṃ/ la s+yaṃ/ ha s+yaṃ/ wa d+yaṃ nṛ taṃ/ gī taṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rol mo byin 'bebs spyi dang mthun par byin dbab bo// bdag bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs= sogs skyabs sems lan gsum byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i rwa ba'i (484)dbus na sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ oṃ paṃ bi shwa badz+ra pad+maṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan/ oṃ ra badz+ra sūr+ya badz+ra sūr+ya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po'i mdog can/ mdun zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ zhal re re zhing spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag dar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de rnams re re la yang mthe bong ser po/ 'dzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang gu'o// de rnams re re la yang tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po// de lta bu'i g.yas kyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/

khro bo'i rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gug /mda'/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ ḍā ma ru/ tho ba/ 'khor lo// mdung*/ dbyug pa/ dgra sta rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ dung*/ me long*/ rdo rje'i lcags sgrog /tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa (485)'dzin pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis g.yas pa nag po dang*/ g.yon pa ser pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su gyon pa/ bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bdud dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi rgyal po rnams kyi snying gar mnan pa/ klu'i dbang po rgyal ba ral pa'i cod pan la bcings shing*/ rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings te gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa// 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ spyi bor thod pa lnga'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar haṃ/ gtsug tor du k+ṣaḥ de nas spro zhing nus na/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun sngags dbang du blang zhing*/ rgyan bkod rnams kyang rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ oṃ a i ṛ u li pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur mi spyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ la sogs pas mchod/

rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po// dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa (486)can// khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal// rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin// khro bo'i dbang po kun gyi gtso// dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i rig sngags ci nus su bzla zhing*/ de dag mi shes pa'am/ mi nus na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa badz+ra be ga hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ci nus su bzla/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dha in dro3 haṃ/ kro dhā nāṃ/ ā dz+nyā dā ya ka swā hā/ zhes pa'ang khro bo rnams bskul ba'i don du bzla zhing*/ oṃ a ra ra ra ra/ la la la la/ badz+ra ā be sha ya hūm̐/ ces pa'ang ye shes dbab pa'i don du bzla'o// bzla tshul gzhan yang*/ oṃ hwe phaṭa/ ces 'bum gyis bsnun pa dang*/ oṃ y+we hūm̐/ 'bum gyis dbab pa dang*/ oṃ rwe bau ṣa ṭa/ 'bum gyis bsreg pa dang*/ oṃ w+we na maḥ 'bum gyis bslang ba dang*/ oṃ lwe swā hā/ 'bum gyis rgyas pa dang*/ oṃ beṃ wa phaṭa/ 'bum gyis mnyes par bya ba rnams thugs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra be ga swā hā/ 'bum phrag bcu gsung gi bzlas pa dang*/ gong du bshad pa'i snying po bye ba sku'i bzlas pa'o// de'ang rang don bsnyen pa la skyabs sems can bzlas pa'i bar btang la mthar/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang ci rigs par sgom zhing*/ thun mtshams su yang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya/ rjes gnang skabs sku'i bzlas pa brgya rtsa/ gsung bzlas stong phrag /khro bo bskul ba dang*/ ye shes dbab pa ci rigs bzlas pas chog go /de nas mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i rwa ba'i dbus na sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ sogs nas/ yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs/ sogs gong bdag bskyed ltar la/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// ha hā/

yi yī/ wu wū/ ll̥ ll̥ rnams las byung ba'i khro bo bcu dang*/ nga dā/ nyi nyī/ (487)mū/ rnams las byung ba'i zad par bcu dang*/ gha ghā/ dzhi dzhī/ dhṛ dhṛ// rnams las byung ba'i phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ ga gā/ dzi dzī/ bu bū/ rnams las byung ba'i gza' bcu dang*/ kha khā/ tshi tshī/ ṭhṛ ṭh+ṝ/ phu phū/ rnams las byung ba'i klu bcu dang*/ ka kā/ tsi tsī/ pu pū/ rnams las byung ba'i 'byung po bcu rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi nas mchod bstod yan gong ltar lags/ bstod pa'i mthar/ khro bo bcu dang zad par bcu// phyogs skyong bcu dang gza' mchog bcu// klu rgyal bcu dang 'byung po bcu// srung ma drug cu'i tshogs la 'dud// ces bstod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi sho dha ni sarba dra byā ṇi bi sho dha ya hūm̐ phreṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod pas rdzas mtha' dag byin gyis rlob par 'gyur la/ shes shing lcogs na sngags tshan bzhi pos byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes lan mang du brjod/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*// grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni// lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*/ mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbadz+ra bhai ra wā ya bhī sa ka rā ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ uṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sum+bha (488)ni sum+bha/ bi gha nān+ta ka /nī la daṇ+ḍa/ pradz+nyān+ta ka ṭāk+ki rā dza pad+mān+ta ka /a tsa la/ ya mān+ta ka /ma hā ba le bh+yaḥ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ ā ka sha /bā yu/ te dza/ u da ka /pṛ thi bi/ sā dhi te bh+yaḥ zhes gri gug gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ brah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu/ niraṛ t+ya/ wā yu/ ya ma/ ag+ni/ sa mu dra/ ī shwa ra/ in+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ zhes ral gri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ rā hu/ kā lāg+ni tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ bud+dha/ maṅga la/ shu kra/ bṛ ha sa pa ti/ ke tu sha ni bh+yaḥ zhes rin po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa/ ba su ki /shaṅkha pā la/ ku li ka /a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka /ma hā pad+me bh+yaḥ zhes pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ be ta ṭa/ bi kṛ ta mu kha/ shwa/ kā ka /su kā ra/ gṛ dha/ byā ghā/ ū lu ka /dzaṃ bu ka /ga ru ḍa mu khe bh+yaḥ zhes 'khor lo'i phyag rgya rnams kyi so sor spyan drangs shing bzhugs su gsol la/ re re'i mtha' 'am bsdu na/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā ra shri ghāṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ kha dan+tu/ pi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛp+ta/ sarba sa twā naṃ/ shān+ting*/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ/ ā wa ra ṇa/ gup+tiṃ ku ྼྺn+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra adz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes thun mong du lan gsum phul/ spro na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ yul bdag grong bdag rnams la'ang sbyin// 'di ni mchod gtor lhan cig tu 'bul ba'i tshul yin pas/ gtor ma'i rjes la mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul ba med kyang chog /deng sang gi lag len ltar na/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ badz+ra bhe ra wa/ ha ya ra wa/ (489)la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes nang mchod phul/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/

slob ma rnams la chab btang*/ gral du 'khod nas me tog bkye bsdu dang*/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ 'dir skabs su babs pa/ rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi rtse mor gyur pa bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi la sogs pa khams gsum gyi bgegs dang bar gcod thams cad 'joms shing srung ba la rab tu bsngags pa mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid 'jigs byed khro bo chen po'i skur bstan pa/ srid pa gsum las shin tu rnam par rgyal ba'i sna tshogs gzugs can gyi khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'di dag thun mong du zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs dang bar du gcod pa mtha' dag zhi zhing mi tshugs pa'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa dang gtor ma'i cho ga la 'jug pas mtshon las rab 'byams sgrub pa dang*/ khyad par rim pa dang po'i skabs su khams drug gi 'pho ba las gyur pa'i gegs dang bar gcod ngang gis zhi ba dang rim pa gnyis pa'i skabs su lus kyi 'khor lo drug gi lte bar rlung sems mtha' dag 'ching ba'i grogs byed cing mthar thug rgyal ba rigs drug gi go 'phang la sbyor ba'i dgos pa khyad par can dang 'brel pas (490)rgyud 'di'i rnal 'byor pas sgom sgrub mchod pa'i lam la brtson pa cis kyang gal che bas/ de nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song*/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bzhu/ zhes pas brda sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug / thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mi bzod 'khor bas 'jigs pa dag ni di ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi// khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrogs dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so//

zhes lan gsum/ rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs la sangs rgyas sems dpa' khro bo dang srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad bshags shing*/ zag bcas zag med kyi dge ba mtha' dag la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ dkon mchog khyad par can de dag la skyabs su 'gro zhing rang rang gi lus longs spyod 'bul pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing nam yang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba dang*/ de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa bas mar gyur sems can rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par smon pa ste yan lag bdun pa'i don re re bzhin gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos// srid 'gro nyams ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni// shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni// (491)sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnams bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pa'i rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dag pa gsum gyis bdag gis dngos 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag brdzid do//

ces lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas rgyal ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag tshul bzhin bsrung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan pos 'di'i rjes zlos/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi// rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi// ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa dag ni bskyang bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ lan gsum/ de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing slob ma la bdud rtsi sbyin/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hoḥser po/ gsang bar haṃ ljang gu// gtsug tor duk+ṣa sngon po rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces gnas drug tu thig le drug bkod la byin gyis brlab/ de (492)nas rjes gnang gzhi dgod pa'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas sgo gsum gyi byed pa bcings la dmigs pa 'di rnams rtse gcig sgoms mdzod/ slob dpon khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs gtso rkyang dang*// mdun bskyed khro rgyal rdo rje shugs la sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs kyi bskor nas bzhugs par mos shig /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la phog pas gdos bcas sha khrag gis mtshon pa'i dngos po thams cad sbyangs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa

sogs sgrub thabs ltar gtso bor bskyed/ ye shes spyan 'dren skabs gu gul dud pa dang rol mo'i sgra sbyar/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥrnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces gnas bzhi byin brlab/ oṃ a i ri u sogs kyis dbang bsdus pa bskur/ de nas rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i rjes su gnang ba bzhi yod pas rim bzhin dmigs pa 'di rnams sgoms shig /slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i dpral ba nas klu bcu dang*/ 'byung po bcu dpag tu med pa spros nas slob ma'i dpral bar thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la rol mo'i sgra bya/ de'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba'o// yang slob dpon dang mdud bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i mgrin pa nas phyogs skyong dang gza' bcu dpag tu (493)med pa spros nas slob ma'i mgrin par thim par gyur/ rol mo bya/ de ni gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'o/ yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka nas zad par bcu dang khro bo bcu dpag tu med pa spros te slob ma'i snying gar thim par gyur/ rol mo bya/ de ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis ba'i lte ba nas khro bo rdo rje shugs nyid dpag tu med pa spros te slob ma'i lte bar thim par gyur/ rol mo bya/ de ni ye shes kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bya ba la/ gtor ma 'di nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang bcas par gsal ba spyi bor spyan drangs te phrin las gsol bas ji ltar smon pa'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par yid bzhin tu rtsal cing 'dod pa'i don bde blag tu sgrub par mos shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/

bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ dus kyi 'khor lo// shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal/ rigs ldan nyer lnga rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dus zhabs pa che chung*/ zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon a bhā ya ka ra/ legs spyod/ ā nan+da/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ kun spangs thugs rje btson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho (494)rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen dol po pa chen po/ 'ga' rong pa lha'i rgyal mtshan/ rje brtson pa ba/ bdag chen rnam rgyal grags pa/ shangs ston kun dga' dpal ldan/ pan chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje shes rab bkra shis/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho/ gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon po la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po yongs kyi dbang phyug rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje shugs 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal chen po dang*/ nyid kyi ye shes rang snang las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srung ma drug cu'i cho gas khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs ye shes nus mthu chen pos/ che ge 'di rnams la srung ba dang sba ba dang byin gyis brlab par= klu rgyal bcu dang 'byung po bcus lus kyi khams byin gyis brlab par= gza' mchog bcu dang phyogs skyong bcus ngag gi khams byin gyis brlab par= zad par bcu dang khro bo bcus yid kyi khams= khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyis ye shes kyi khams=

khams gsum gyi bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i tshogs kyi 'ching ba rtsa lags dang bcas pa gang gis kyang brdzi mi nus par= sgo gsum mi phyed rdo rje lta bur byin= rdo rje'i slob ma 'di/ sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog gi dngos grub dam pa thob pa'i phyir/ mthar (495)thug bzhi'i rab tu dbye ba'i bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor zab mo mthar phyin cing rig sngags kyi mchog grub par= ral gri mig sman rkang mgyogs ril bu bcud len sogs dngos grub phra mo rnams dang*/ 'dod gzugs kyi rigs pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rnams tshe 'di la thob par= zhi rgyas la sogs pa dge ba'i phrin las dang*/ dbang 'gugs la sogs pa gang 'dul gyi phrin las thogs med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gsad bcad la sogs pa drag po dang rmongs rengs la sogs pa rnam par gnon pa'i las thams cad thogs med du= 'khor lo drug tu rlung sems dbu mar bcings khams drug sgrib bral du rnam par dag pa'i dwangs ma rdo rje'i srog thob cing rgyal ba rigs drug gi go 'phang myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa badz+ra be ga hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ sogs/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim par mos shig / gsum pa rjes rim ni/ des dpal dus kyi 'khor lo khro bo'i dbang po'i tshul bstan pa 'jigs byed rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi rjes gnang legs par thob pa yin pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig tshul bzhin tu bsrung ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal sogs dang*/ gtong rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ sogs yon phul/ dge ba bsngo/ mdun bskyed kyi

(496) mchod pa kha gsos/ gong bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas phul/ bstod pa bya/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ zhes gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtsug tor du aṃ yig la zad par 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol// dpral bar i yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol// snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ lte bar l̥ yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ zhes mdun bskyed rnams rang la bsdu/ rang yang zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la bsdus te lha'i nga rgyal lam du khyer/ bsngo ba ni/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyi lhan skyes bde ba mchog sgom ste// 'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku 'di chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas// lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs shing*// dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin tu mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig / ces sogs smon lam gdab cing bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa brjod do// bcu drug 'jigs pas mi 'jigs shing*// (497) sa steng bgegs rigs rnam par nyams// khams drug 'gyur ba med bsrungs nas// rgyal ba drug 'dus sku thob shog /ces gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod kyi nang tshan zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi cha lag tu nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te/ blo gros mtha' yas kyis rdzong shod shangs kyi zab lung gnyis par sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol byung ba blags chog tu bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
